arguments.title: Northstar Observatory
arguments.brief: Responsive internal single-site night-operations console. Shared navigation reaches Night, Targets, Timeline, Systems, and Handoff. Keep ACTIVE night state and UTC/local control visible throughout.

binding.content: DESKTOP dashboard / NARROW stacked cards. Persistent Northstar shared nav (Night, Targets, Timeline, Systems, Handoff), ACTIVE night state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Critical wind warning: 38 km/h, dome close threshold approaching. Local 22:14 EDT | UTC 02:14. Weather clear, -3 C, humidity 28%. Dome open / warning; telescope tracking M42 / healthy. Current target M42, exposure 3 of 8. Next: 22:30 slew NGC 2024; 23:10 autofocus. Include populated, loading weather, and empty next-event examples.

DESKTOP table / NARROW stacked cards. Persistent nav, ACTIVE state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Search and filters: status, priority, visibility. Ranked queue columns: rank, object, type, priority, visibility window, estimated duration, status. 1 M42 | nebula | P1 | 21:40–03:50 | 48 min | observing; 2 NGC 2024 | nebula | P2 | 22:30–04:10 | 35 min | queued; 3 M31 | galaxy | P3 | 00:20–05:40 | 55 min | queued. Include empty filtered results and loading queue; open M42 detail.

DESKTOP two columns / NARROW one column. Persistent nav, ACTIVE state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Breadcrumb Targets > M42 and visible Back to target queue. M42 Orion Nebula: RA 05h35m17s, Dec -05d23m28s; finder-preview placeholder; visibility rises 19:22, transit 00:41, sets 05:56, altitude 47 degrees; exposure 8 x 360s L plus 6 x 300s R/G/B; notes check wind before slew. Actions: Queue next, Skip tonight, Mark observed. Include warning, loading finder, and empty notes states.

DESKTOP timeline / NARROW chronological cards. Persistent nav, ACTIVE state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Completed: polar alignment 20:05, calibration 20:40. Current: M42 exposure at 22:14. Upcoming: NGC 2024 slew 22:30; M31 sequence 00:20. Delayed: guider calibration planned 21:55, now 22:45 because of wind. Include loading and empty upcoming examples.

DESKTOP grid / NARROW stacked cards. Persistent nav, ACTIVE state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Telescope HEALTHY tracking; Dome WARNING wind threshold; Camera HEALTHY -15 C; Guider OFFLINE no lock; Weather station WARNING intermittent gust sensor. Healthy/warning/offline legend. Troubleshooting: guider reset, dome wind interlock, weather last reading. Include loading telemetry and empty diagnostics.

DESKTOP three columns / NARROW stacked sections. Persistent nav, ACTIVE state, LOCAL/UTC toggle. Completed observations: M42 partial L sequence, calibration frames. Unresolved alerts: critical wind, guider offline, gust sensor. Next-shift priorities: diagnose guider, resume M42 if wind clears, execute NGC 2024. Action: Download handoff. Include populated, loading export, and empty completed-observations examples.
